text: Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) is a major update to Valve's legendary tactical shooter, ported to the modern Source 2 engine. The game retains the classic mechanics of the confrontation between terrorists and counter-terrorists, but features completely redesigned graphics, dynamic lighting, and an innovative "responsive" smoke system. Core esports maps have been visually overhauled, and the transition to a new sub-tick system has made shooting and movement smoother and more precise compared to CS:GO.
